summary: Iter23 – Backend + Frontend testing of Japanese mutual fund support (投資信託協会 official library + Yahoo!ファイナンス fallback) added to security search / quote, plus price_unit field on assets and price_unit-aware valuation. Backend: 14/14 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_fund_search.py — /api/quote/search: '18312991' → returns exactly {ticker=18312991, isin=JP90C0002EX1, asset_class=fund, country=JP, currency=JPY, price_unit=10000, source=toushin, price≈8363}; 'JP90C0002EX1' → 18312991; 'オルカン' → 0331418A eMAXIS Slim全世界株式; '世界のベスト' → several インベスコ funds; 'emaxis slim' (ASCII) → JP fund results via Yahoo JP fallback; 'トヨタ' still returns 7203.T (jp_stock) among results; apple→AAPL / VOO→etf / BTC→BTC-USD / 7203→7203.T still work. /api/quote: fund code 18312991 returns full fund payload with price_unit=10000 and price_date; ISIN JP90C0002EX1 resolves to 18312991; 0331418A also resolves; unknown 8-char '99999999' → 404; stocks (7203, AAPL) unchanged. Asset valuation: created asset qty=1200000 acq=8000 cur=8363 price_unit=10000 → current_value=1,003,560 acquisition_total=960,000 (exact match, verified via GET /api/data/assets); stock with price_unit=1 unchanged. Frontend (client@finora.co.jp on /assets): 銘柄検索 renders, typing '18312991' → security-result-18312991 dropdown; clicking it fills ticker=18312991, name='インベスコ世界厳選株式オープンF(毎月決算型)《世界のベスト》', asset_class=fund, current_price=8363, price_date=2026-09-25, price_unit=10000, currency=JPY, country=JP; save with quantity 1200000 acq 8000 → portfolio table shows value ¥1,003,560 and 結果 ¥43,560 exactly (screenshot confirmed). 'オルカン' shows security-result-0331418A. Switching from fund→stock (トヨタ → 7203.T) resets price_unit back to '' (empty). i18n: JA header '銘柄検索（コード・銘柄名・投資信託）' + option '1万口あたり（投資信託の基準価額）'; EN 'Find security (code, name or mutual fund)' + 'Per 10,000 units (JP mutual fund NAV)'; PT 'Buscar ativo (código, nome ou fundo)' + 'Por 10.000 cotas (fundo japonês)'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow (docWidth=scrollWidth=390 on /assets and with Add dialog open).

issues: Pre-existing dev-only React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in field-account_id. Non-blocking, present since iter20/21/22 – no regression.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/fund.py: 協会コード → resolve() strategy uses Yahoo JP quote page title to obtain the fund name, then queries toushin-lib with wide-char-encoded keyword and filters by exact code. Works, but is a 2-round-trip and depends on <title>...【 pattern in Yahoo HTML — fragile. Consider caching the (code → item) mapping to a persistent collection like db.jp_funds analogous to db.jp_securities for reliability & speed (currently 10-min in-memory cache only).

backend/quote.py search: merges local[:6] + funds[:6] + remote[:6], capped at 15. Skips Yahoo Search for fund-code queries. Good – prevents polluting the result with unrelated Yahoo hits when we already know it's a fund code.
backend/analytics.py enrich: uses `a.get('price_unit') or 1` – safe against None/0/missing. Correctly propagates to value_jpy through fx multiplication.
backend/calc.py positions.market_value: also divides by price_unit — good; keeps transactions-derived positions consistent with the asset-list valuation when the user is holding a fund.
backend/crud.py assets: price_unit is in num field list, so it's coerced to float. Storage as float is fine; frontend passes '10000' string and enrich reads it back correctly.

frontend/SecuritySearch.jsx fill(): `set('price_unit', x.price_unit ? String(x.price_unit) : '')` – correctly clears when swapping fund→stock (verified). It always writes price_unit (even when empty), so the semantic is 'always control this field'. Good.

The fund.resolve fallback (yahoo → toushin) is slow (up to ~4s) but wrapped in 20s wait_for; frontend shows busy spinner. Consider adding a proper JSON search endpoint if toushin adds one, to reduce latency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% – all required flows (fund code fill, オルカン search, valuation via table, stock reset, JA/EN/PT i18n, mobile 390)

test_credentials: client@finora.co.jp / Finora2026! for /assets add flow; consultant@finora.co.jp / Finora2026! for /api/quote/search backend tests.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and deletes a TEST_QA fund asset (ticker 18312991, qty 1.2M) under 佐藤 健一. UI test cleanup uses fetch DELETE /api/data/assets/{id} for any residual インベスコ fund rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_fund_search.py + test_security_search.py (34 tests, ~30s). External deps: toushin-lib.fwg.ne.jp (投資信託協会 JSON API, ~1-3s) and finance.yahoo.co.jp (HTML scraping of quote page + search page). Both must be reachable; each fund lookup goes through httpx with 15s timeout wrapped in 20s wait_for. If toushin fails, ASCII-alphabetic queries fall back to yahoo_jp search (marketName='投資信託'). fund.py has a 10-min in-memory _CACHE keyed by ticker for resolve() – re-running tests may hit cache. New fields: price_unit on assets (num, default 1). Any new asset creation UI/backend must set price_unit or it stays 1.
rca of the issue: N/A – no defects. Initial run appeared to fail two fund-quote tests due to slow first request to toushin-lib (>15s). Reran with pytest -n0 (single worker) – all pass in ~10s. Playwright fill of fund via UI end-to-end produced value ¥1,003,560 exactly (visible in table screenshot).
